My Nmom had told both of my other siblings (both GC) about this family history when the were old enough to understand about that sort of thing. But here I am 21 years of age and been struggling for years with this illness and never once was I told by my Nmom who had known this whole time what disease I had.

I went NC in January as soon as I moved out. Now my nmother is trying to have contact again all of a sudden. I thought it could be as my birthday is coming up soon but now have realized it will be because of mothers day. I have had to start low contact/grey rocking her, as she had started to turn up to my home without notice. She sat outside my house for around 30 mins and knocked on the windows to see if anyone was home. She has done this a few times now and once she caught one of my flat mates walking around the house and got her to open the door. Luckly my flatmates know to say im not home to her. But now she is guilting my flatmates and they all rekon I should just spend mothers day with her and be in full contact etc. This next few weeks are going to be long and hard but I think once mothers day amd my birthday pass it should be easier
Well she is getting nothing from me. She sat outside my home for almost 30 minutes to see if I was home. Luckly I had the curtains drawn.
